arguments.title: Evergreen usage continuity — November 2025 to June 2026
arguments.body: Evergreen closed November 2025 at 223 monthly active developers and June 2026 at 219. Both months fell into one standard Growth overage band: the plan includes up to 200 monthly active developers, with $1,000 charged per additional 50. The overage was handled under the existing Growth terms in both cases; neither month required custom commercial terms, a department carveout, or a contract change.
